_note: End-of-season result. Endings are tried in order; the first whose bars are all met wins, and the last one (no bars) catches the rest. A bar left out is open. Accuracy is the mean weighted accuracy over the days played (0 to 1), integrity the mean integrity (0 to the max in balance.json scoring.integrity.start), failed_days the shifts the line gave up on. Reason text can use {accuracy}, {min_accuracy}, {integrity}, {min_integrity}, {max_integrity}, {failed_days} and {max_failed_days}. integrity_story is the day report's line explaining today's integrity ({points} is signed).

reasons.accuracy_ok: You scored {accuracy}% on your calls, with hard calls counting extra. The bar was {min_accuracy}%.
reasons.accuracy_low: You scored {accuracy}% on your calls, with hard calls counting extra. That's under the bar of {min_accuracy}%.
reasons.integrity_ok: Integrity {integrity} out of {max_integrity}. The bar was {min_integrity}.
reasons.integrity_low: Integrity {integrity} out of {max_integrity}, under the bar of {min_integrity}. Favors and false alarms cost you.
reasons.failed_days_ok: Shifts the line gave up on: {failed_days}. Allowed: {max_failed_days}.
reasons.failed_days_low: Shifts the line gave up on: {failed_days}. Allowed: {max_failed_days}.

integrity_story.outro: Integrity counts toward whether you keep the post.
